name: Omni NFT
fix_description: In executeWithdrawERC721, the NToken.burn() call (which triggers safeTransferFrom → onERC721Received callback) happens before validateHFAndLtv health factor check. Fix: add nonReentrant modifier to executeWithdrawERC721 and liquidationERC721, or move the burn (external call) after all state validation to follow checks-effects-interactions pattern.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a long, protocol-specific multi-contract attack involving a Balancer flash loan, an NFTX flash loan, NFT redeem/mint flows, Omnibridge-style NFT collateral lending, liquidation logic, and ERC721 callback-driven state manipulation. Understanding and reproducing it requires deep reasoning about cross-contract accounting and callback timing, well beyond a straightforward exploit pattern.
